semantics.roundId: First valid tile interaction, hint, shuffle, or bomb starts one stable round; the round spans the session until the player restarts or the game ends in a terminal loss.
semantics.completion: Complete the round when the current session ends or the player restarts; board-clearing level advances do not end the round.
semantics.score: Snapshot the visible score at finalization and submit it once when the round ends, retrying only the failed operation.
semantics.pauseResume: Host pause stops board input, timers, and scheduled callbacks without resetting the board or round; resume continues the same session.
semantics.muteUnmute: Host mute controls effective audio output only and must not overwrite the player's saved music or SFX preferences.
